why: Reject-to-null dropped, so `?dev=1&arrival=converge` becomes an `ArrivalLanguage` that no consumer branches on -- every `=== 'opposed'` test fails and the build renders the shipped language while the URL says otherwise. The same guard `topbar`, `menuTransition`, `mineWarn`, `blockedFire` and `backdrop` each carry. `converge` and `detonate` are the near-misses that matter here: they name the two halves of this language and are exactly what someone who read the issue would type.
killedBy: parseDevFlags: arrival (issue #230 -- spawn and death told apart) rejects anything else to null rather than guessing -- population: the 6 forms below
